ApiEngineInput.description:
API-boundary input compatible with the merged engine SDK while retaining
the legacy Rust `options` envelope. Canonical SDK fields are normalized
once into `EngineInput::options` before dispatch.

oneOf.description:
Legacy flat birth data. Still accepted for backward compatibility.
Prefer `subjects[]` + `report_level` for L0-L5 and multi-subject flows.

language.description:
Optional language code for orchestrator/prompt selection (e.g. "hi", "en").
Additive first-class field. Top-level (not inside relationship_context).

oneOf.description: Rich relationship framing for multi-subject reports (e.g. synastry, family, business).

subjects.description:
One or more subjects (primary + optional partners).
Every subject MUST carry a `normalized_location` for the rich path
(enforced by the isComplete gate).

source_pack.description: Minimal source-pack manifest (full factory lives in witness-pipeline).

CalculationMetadata.description: Metadata about how a calculation was performed

cached.description: Whether the result was retrieved from cache

calculation_time_ms.description: Time taken for the calculation in milliseconds

altitude.description: Altitude in meters above sea level

DependencyHealthEntry.description:
Deliberately small, allowlisted dependency entry. URLs, versions, errors,
credentials, and transport details never cross this response boundary.

EngineInput.description: Input to any consciousness engine calculation

result.description: Engine-specific result data (each engine defines its own schema)

witness_prompt.description: Self-inquiry question generated from the calculation

EphemerisChecksumsResponse.description: Response body for the ephemeris checksums endpoint.

checksums.description: Map of `.se1` filename to its hex-encoded SHA256 digest.

key_observation.example: soft jawline with high brow curvature

FinancialBiosensorResultSchema.description:
Financial Biosensor — a composed decision-reflection surface.

The index is a declared house model, not a forecast. `formula_version`
identifies the constants that produced it, so two numbers from two builds
are never silently compared.

guidance.example: Return to the center before moving outward

language.description:
Optional language code for prompt/orchestrator selection (e.g. "hi", "en").
Top-level on request (orchestrator concern, not relationship_context).

UpdateUserRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v1/users/me request body.

Note: email changes are intentionally excluded. Email is a security-sensitive
field (auth bypass risk) and requires out-of-band verification. Use
POST /api/v1/users/me/change-email (future endpoint) for email changes.

ValidationResult.description: Result of validating an engine output

WorkflowResult.description: Result from executing a multi-engine workflow

bearer_auth.description: JWT token obtained from authentication endpoint
